summary: The documents provide the structure and behavior of the StudentPayHistory system in HSPnet, focusing on the roles and responsibilities of handling student pay history within the application.
purpose: To manage and document the pay history of students in the HSPnet system, including adding, updating, and retrieving student pay history data.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the StudentPayHistory entry.

fields.name: StudentID
fields.description: Identifier for the student associated with the pay history entry.

fields.name: CreatedByUserID
fields.description: Identifier of the user who created the entry.

fields.name: EffectiveDate
fields.description: The date from which the pay history is effective.

fields.name: EmploymentClassCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the employment class of the student.

fields.name: DesignationCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the designation of the student.

fields.name: StatusCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the status of the student.

fields.name: StatusReasonCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the reason for the status of the student.

fields.name: PayLevelCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the pay level of the student.

fields.name: PayLevelReasonCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the reason for the pay level of the student.

fields.name: YearCodeID
fields.description: Code representing the year of the pay history entry.

fields.name: FixedTermAppointmentCodeID
fields.description: Code representing fixed term appointment status.

fields.name: FixedTermAppointmentNotes
fields.description: Notes related to the fixed term appointment.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Session object used to interact with the database for student pay history operations.

workflows.name: AddStudentPayHistory
steps: Initialize HSPnetSession and set procedure name to 'StudentDetailsPayHistoryAdd'.

Add parameters to the session for session ID, student ID, created by user ID, effective date, employment class code ID, designation code ID, status code ID, status reason code ID, pay level code ID, pay level reason code ID, year code ID, fixed term appointment code ID, and fixed term appointment notes.

workflows.name: UpdateStudentPayHistory
steps: Initialize HSPnetSession and set procedure name to 'StudentDetailsPayHistoryUpdate'.

Add parameters to the session for session ID, ID, effective date, employment class code ID, designation code ID, status code ID, status reason code ID, pay level code ID, pay level reason code ID, year code ID, fixed term appointment code ID, and fixed term appointment notes.

workflows.name: DeleteStudentPayHistory
steps: Initialize HSPnetSession and set procedure name to 'StudentPayHistoryDelete'.
Add parameters to the session for session ID and ID.

workflows.name: SearchStudentPayHistory
steps: Initialize HSPnetSession and set procedure name to 'StudentDetailsPayHistorySearch'.
Add parameters to the session for student ID and session ID.
Retrieve data using SqlDataReader and fill the entry with the data from the reader.
Close the data reader and return the list of StudentPayHistory entries.

system_behavior.description: The system allows for adding, updating, searching, and deleting student pay history entries.
System automatically defaults certain fields if no recent entry is found during data retrieval.

exceptions.description: If no data is returned during a search, the system initializes default values for fields.
